name: Selvadorada
blurb: Enjoy learning about the Selvadorada culture, or explore the jungle's hidden secrets. But be prepared! It won't be an easy trek through the jungle.

neighbourhoods.name: Puerto Llamante Marketplace
neighbourhoods.desc: Come enjoy the sights and sounds of Selvadorada!

neighbourhoods.name: Belomisia Jungle
neighbourhoods.desc: The jungle is teeming with wondrous sights and hidden dangers. Brave adventurers can explore the ruins of the ancient Omiscans. Skilled Sims and those equipped with gear from the marketplace will do well here.

weather: Sunny most of the year, no snow, heat waves in summer

highlights.name: Explore the Jungle
highlights.text: It's literally a jungle out there! Don't forget to bring your spider repellent and machete!

highlights.name: Hidden Temple
highlights.text: The more you explore, the more secret ancient rooms open up for discovery

highlights.name: Ancient Artifacts
highlights.text: Find, purchase, and collect ancient artifacts so you can bring a piece of the jungle home with you
